skill.summary: Monitors the OpenCode Zen pricing page for new free models and offers to update your default configuration.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of opencode-zen-check-free-models.
- Monitors OpenCode Zen pricing page for new free AI models.
- Alerts users when new free models become available.
- Offers to set newly discovered free models as the default for OpenClaw configurations.
- Avoids duplicate prompts by tracking previously seen free models in a workspace JSON file.
